title: Motion-matching vs blend-tree spike (Movement Bible §13)
summary: Build the ~110-clip motion database with the open motion matcher, deploy to a current and an older iPhone, and measure over 5 minutes of scripted play. The Bible §13 thresholds are v1 targets (AUTH #003), not merge gates; the deliverable is the built database, the measurements, and a locked recommendation. Motion Warping (AUTH #001) is purchased under this ticket.

acceptance_tests.test: The ~110-clip database (Bible §11 whitelist) is built with the open MIT matcher and runs on device with inertialized blending; the motion-db size and animation CPU are reported.

A recommendation is recorded (motion matching if the targets hold on device, else blend trees with inertialization) with the measurements behind it; ADR-0004 is updated by AUTH if the fallback is chosen.
Motion Warping: Climb & Interact (AUTH #001) is imported and recorded in the Unity package list with its version and license.

Over 5 minutes of scripted play (run loops, 20 mantles, 10 falls) the Bible §13 targets (≥30 fps p99, ≤4 ms animation, ≤60 MB) are met on the reference iPhones; warp lands hands within 0.05 A on the test edges.
